details.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p=Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'web-mcp-assistant\accepted-code-activation.json'; if(!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)){Write-Error 'accepted-code-activation.json missing'; exit 3}; $s=Get-Content -LiteralPath $p -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; [pscustomobject]@{path=$p;version=$s.version;active_checkpoint_id=$s.active_checkpoint_id;baseline=$s.baseline;closure_input=$s.closure_input} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12"
